message: Resolve the original-pixel input blocker for this bounded48-case BD12/13 subset now. Reuse these artifacts instead of requesting recapture or waiting for training admission. This is a narrower executable slice, not completion of every requested native corpus.
binding: Extract each archive into a new source-specific root. Index source selects that archive; its image/evidence paths are archive-relative. Require exactly48unique(source,caseID) rows,24per source, two ordered before/after images per row, every indexed hash and referenced file present. The index includes existing DTM053/054 change probabilities and model hashes; local model paths are identity references, not required worker paths. No checkpoint transfer or new inference needed. Reject links/traversal/duplicates/special files; at most500members/40MiB expanded per archive,32MiB/member; check free space first. Retain failures, no automatic retry or overwrite.
roles: Every case is calibration-inspection-only. Embedded validation folders and recorded conditions are historical producer assertions, not independent holdout labels. Capture-era source/build binding remains unresolved. No training, threshold tuning, final evaluation, label repair or data admission. Do not pass these as authoritative native references for218.
work: BD13: hash/decode/dimensions/bounds/crop consistency and duplicate/byte-identical pairs over original indexed files. Report typed case-linked defects; distinguish unsupported metadata from corruption. Compare archive per-file manifests where provided, without executing archive code or HTML. Flag reported labels/source contradictions as unverified findings, not repaired truth.

BD12: use cached probabilities only at frozen no-change<=0.15/change>=0.85/otherwise abstain. Produce all48case dispositions, counts by reported condition, deterministic top10disagreement/anomaly categories and stable representative IDs. Rank by count then stable category ID; include denominators and duplicates/group limitations. Describe agreement with reported conditions, never accuracy or false-stable risk. TTR owns review of uncertain labels.

Return source/tests and compact JSON/Markdown reports, exact input hashes, complete accounting, elapsed time and missing fields. No raw-image retransfer; refer to stable archive/case/frame IDs. Share one <=16MiB return archive/200regular files/64MiB expanded. Publish exact receipts for the three input files before sender cleanup.
budget: 4CPU hours total,2threads,nice10 where supported,128MiB new outputs excluding verified input copies. No GPU, downloads, installations, services, capture, model execution, training, Git writes or editing another namespace. Preserve other active work; acknowledge/start/terminal separately.
next: NUIAK independently reviews defect and condition-disagreement counts; TTR resolves source binding and label findings. Unavailable source authority blocks accuracy/training only, not this raw QA slice.
